FN-IQINWWW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 286
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility & Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/10/2024
Senate Bill 286 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Commerce by an undetermined amount to issue sales, use and lodgings tax exemption
certificates to qualified production companies and adopt rules as necessary to administer the
provisions of this bill and would decrease the administrative obligations of the Department of
Revenue by a corresponding amount. Additionally, this bill could increase the financial
obligations of the Department of Commerce by an undetermined amount dependent on the
difference in: 1) the annual salary of the Director of the Alabama Film Office set by the
Secretary of the Department of Commerce above the current $48,000 cap pursuant to the
provisions of this bill; and (2) the salary otherwise set by the Governor under current law.
